prompts.b01:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: 16:9 LAiDIES animated-comic Trailer frame, isolated wardrobe replacement candidate
Input images: Image 1 is the exact edit target and controls all composition, character identity, pose, facial expression, hair, six butterfly clips, bag, street, buildings, lighting, comic rendering, and banner text. Image 2 is the wardrobe reference only.
Primary request: In Image 1, replace only the heroine’s yellow plaid blazer-and-skirt outfit with the exact sleeveless multicolour geometric mini dress from Image 2: aqua/teal base, lime bodice, teal straps and waist bands, and large lilac/plum geometric panels. Preserve the white shoulder bag and all other elements from Image 1.
Constraints: keep Image 1’s 1920x1080 landscape composition exactly; preserve the heroine’s face, blue eyes, body, pose, hands, hair, butterfly clips, scale, and location; preserve every building, sign, vehicle, shadow, and the banner wording exactly as visible; no crop, zoom, reframing, new text, extra accessories, extra people, or environmental changes. Change only the clothing. Maintain the same polished vibrant LAiDIES comic illustration style. No watermark.
